findings.review_notes: Keyword proxy1.0 does not establish physical correctness; Arrhenius behavior alone does not directly confirm bulk control.
NEP density dimensions useful, but D* derivation conflates RMS and density conventions; m*sqrt(Hz)/W cannot equal cm*sqrt(Hz)/W without100 conversion.
Claims time constant must be10times shorter than chop period. Post-demodulation filtering does not track the carrier this way; settling/sweep dynamics must be modeled.
Voltage responsivity V/W divided by current noise is dimensionally wrong. Passivation reducing recombination does not by itself prove lower responsivity or a specific1/f mechanism.
